notes.title: Shooting experience update
notes.content:
Hello, dear players!

Here comes the new update.

This update focuses on the combat (shooting) part of the game. The goal is to make everyone have a smoother and refreshing combat experience. The contents of this update are as follows:

1、 Tiger wasp shooting feel Optimization: including Gu Jiuxun’s "Tiger Wasp", EA special weapon "Spirit Spider", Miao Mo's pistol, so as to make them have better shooting accuracy and feedback.

2、 Submachine gun shooting feel Optimization: the effect is the same as above.

3、 Grandpa's beloved baby "Sarah Jean" shooting feel Optimization: Sarah Jean 's range and power are enhanced to a certain extent, making it easier to burst heads, cause damage and hard straight effect to monsters, and better match the power setting of "shotgun".

4、 Optimized shooting feel of quantum jammer: longer range.

5、 Monster overall logic optimization: the monster has more hard straight actions, and the hard straight time will be extended appropriately.

7、	At the same time, new filter effects are added: we provide six filters: normal, pale blue, deep red, dark green and black-and-white. After entering the game, you can click "ESC" to enter the "pause menu" for selection. The picture effect is as follows:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38272519/d551d459dde5b11fbeb7f9c2290446bd9f4b74f8.jpg[/img]

Wish all of players will enjoy this version!

notes.title: Game Story: The evolution of Gu’s Weapons
notes.content:
It’s difficult to research when did the Gulady start to make the Gu’s Weapons. But, as is well-know, the Gulady will feed the insects with her blood when she is very young. She knows much details about the insects and will make a Gu’s Weapon before she attend the rite to be the Gulady.
	
According to legend, at the ancient period, the technology is low, and the Guladies are all little girls, so lightweight and long-range weapon is the best choice for them. (In another tale, the Gulady who use the sword and axe died in battle very quickly, so they begin to use a long-range weapon)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38272519/b561efc05bf8affda4257b89e9df7fd1f1574943.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38272519/13f9ed23b16e2b860921d7f7f5a33dee63e7736c.png[/img]

With the evolution of the way to make the weapons, the Gulady also update the Gu’s Weapons too. At JiuXun’s time, the villagers can make the Gu’s Weapons as a modern gun now with the help of the insect’s speciality. 
 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38272519/54eb9932ae318a9f67ee10778cfc91c7b7e2fc96.png[/img]

notes.title: Game Story: The history of Gu
notes.content:
‘Lady in Tomb’ is a game developed by Magyu Studio and published by LightOn Games. It contains Chinese history, Gu, tomb and antiques culture. In the game, you will play the part of Gu Jiuxun, a Gulady of Miao, go into the tomb, solve the puzzle, defeat the monster to save your little sister, Gu Jiuyue.

Gulady is the protector of the village. In ancient, there is a clan live in the valley in the southwest of China. In the tales, an evil monster lives in the valley and will hunt the people. For fighting against the monster, they choose one girl to be Gulady. 

When she was young, Gulady would learn the mystery Gu, fed the insects by her blood over 10 years. After this, she could create the special weapons by the insects, make herb, and use Gu magic to protect the village. 

At the beginning of the game, Gu Jiuxun is 16 years old, and she should go to attend the rite for being the new Gulady of the village. Her mother is the previous Gulady and had been missed for many years. 

But there is an accident happened during the rite, a monster intrudes and kidnap Jiuyue, your little sister.

Now, hang on your weapons and save your sister...

（The Monster in the valley）
